context:
Goal: each rule has one home.
Problem (rule): the check finds word-for-word copies only. A child that rewords a rule is not caught.
Based on (read): the plan, part c: paraphrase detection is out of scope. Your rule: a gap becomes a debt only after a real incident.
Departs from: main tracks no paraphrase gap — adds a note in the debt store.

options.gain: Ships the check now; no guessing at a hard problem.
options.label: Yes: a note now; a debt after a real incident (recommended)
options.lose: A reworded copy can still slip through.

options.label: No: build paraphrase detection now
options.lose: A model-judged check with false alarms, built before any incident shows the need.

short: One-home Q5 of 5: leave reworded copies to a note for now?
title: One-home check, question 5 of 5: should reworded copies of a rule (same meaning, new words) stay unchecked for now, as a note?
why: From plan PR #1106, at your request on 333 (the plan's question 6).
